outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle in frames 0–60, then closes its gripper around the handle in frames 61–70 (wrist_image). The drawer visibly slides outward in frames 78–93, exposing its interior and side walls (image and left_ego_image). The robot releases and withdraws in frames 101–152 while the drawer remains open (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
